snippet.title: The Apartment – Official Trailer | Psychological Horror About a Neighbor Who Knows Too Much
snippet.description:
A new apartment. A friendly neighbor. Problems with your deliveries.
Welcome.

👁️ Wishlist The Apartment on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4333430/The_Apartment/

The Apartment is a first-person psychological horror game about moving into a new apartment and a polite neighbor who seems to know everything about you. At first he's just friendly. Then he starts knowing what you ordered, what you do, and things you never told him.

Explore a single location that shifts between realistic and surreal states, solve puzzles, decode clues against the clock and try to keep up with rules that don't always stay the same.

🔹 Psychological horror in first person
🔹 Rules that change when you're not looking
🔹 Countdowns, sirens and code-decoding under pressure
🔹 Analog horror / VHS aesthetic
🔹 Fully voiced in 9 languages
🔹 Multiple endings. Not all of them let you survive.

For fans of No, I'm Not a Human and MiSide.

Made by a solo developer.
Coming to Steam in 2026.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌐 Website: https://apartment.games
